label:
<think>
The compilation errors stem from Sponge API 8 breaking changes. Key differences:
- CommandException moved to org.spongepowered.api.command.exception.CommandException.
- CommandSource removed; command execution now uses CommandContext only, with source accessed via context.cause().
- CommandContext moved to org.spongepowered.api.command.parameter.CommandContext.
- CommandExecutor is now in org.spongepowered.api.command.CommandExecutor and its execute signature is execute(CommandContext).
- CommandSpec removed; commands are built via Command.builder() returning Command.Parameterized.
- Text and TextSerializers removed; Sponge 8 uses Kyori Adventure’s Component and LegacyComponentSerializer.
- Player replaced by ServerPlayer and Sponge.getServer() becomes Sponge.server().

To fix:
- Update imports to new packages.
- Change execute signature and adapt source retrieval to use context.cause().first(ServerPlayer.class).
- Update buildSpec to return Command.Parameterized via Command.builder().
- Replace Text creation and sending with Adventure Components.
- Use Sponge.server().player(UUID) and ServerPlayer.

These changes are localized to this class and should align it with Sponge API 8.
</think>
